name: openoutreach
description: An open-source, self-hosted AI agent CLI tool for B2B lead generation that identifies potential leads fitting a described product, explains the reasoning behind each lead's relevance, and automates emailing them directly from the user's mailbox.

inputs.name: product_description
inputs.description: A textual description of the product or service for which leads are being targeted.

inputs.name: email_credentials
inputs.description: User's mailbox credentials or configuration for sending emails.

inputs.name: target_criteria
inputs.description: Parameters or filters defining the ideal characteristics of target leads.

outputs.name: leads_list
outputs.description: A list of identified potential leads who fit the described product criteria.

outputs.name: explanations
outputs.description: Explanations detailing why each lead fits the product or service criteria.

outputs.name: email_status
outputs.description: Results of the email outreach process indicating success or failure per lead.

steps: User provides a detailed description of their B2B product or service via CLI
AI analyzes the product description and identifies target prospects fitting the criteria
AI generates clear explanations for why each lead qualifies as a good fit
User configures email credentials to enable outreach
System automatically sends personalized emails to each lead from user's mailbox
User receives summaries on leads found, explanations, and email delivery status
use_cases: Small and medium-sized B2B companies looking to automate lead generation
Sales teams wanting to generate targeted outreach lists with rationale
Marketers needing to send personalized cold emails at scale from their own mailboxes
Startups seeking a cost-effective, self-hosted CLI tool for lead discovery and engagement
patterns: Natural language understanding to parse product descriptions
Lead persona matching based on product fit criteria
Automated explanation generation linking leads to product features
Automated personalized email outreach from self-hosted mailbox
Command-line interface for self-hosted deployment and usage

prompt_templates.name: lead_identification_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Describe my product: {product_description}. Find people who fit this profile and explain why.

prompt_templates.name: email_personalization_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Generate a personalized outreach email for the lead {lead_name} explaining why {product_description} would benefit them.
